name: azqr-54b86100-blind16-ots
instr:
# A cloud assessment CLI that now misreports from the command line down to its reports, without a test suite

The repository has received 16 separate undocumented edits, and the damage shows up all over normal use of the tool. What it is meant to do is sign in to a cloud account, ask it what is deployed, judge what it finds against a body of recommendations and leave the findings behind as a report; it now gets that wrong from the first thing typed at the prompt to the file left on disk. Nothing about the account, the environment or the way the tool is invoked changed.

Asking the tool what it can do is the first thing that fails. The verb that performs an assessment is still listed with its own description intact, but asking what can be run underneath it lists nothing at all, so the short per-service names that used to hang off it cannot be invoked. Narrowing a run to a single group has also gone soft in one spot: an identifier with nothing between the subscription segment and the slash that follows it is now accepted in silence, where it used to be called out for carrying an empty subscription ID. Every other bad shape is still refused with a format complaint — a bare group name, a missing leading slash, a missing or misspelled segment name, too many segments, too few, and an identifier ending in an empty group name.

Handing in per-step settings as dotted name=value pairs behaves backwards. An entry that is empty or only whitespace, which used to be ignored quietly, now dr
